name: HAKUTO-R Mission 1
intro: Konnichiwa! I'm HAKUTO-R, a private lander carrying a tiny rover from the UAE and a toy-sized robot.
Our target: Atlas crater, in the north-east of the near side.
We also prepared backup sites, just in case.
My laser rangefinder will tell me how high I am. I hope...
briefing: Hmm, my altitude reading says 0 metres... but I'm still 5 km up!
fact: HAKUTO-R crashed because a crater rim confused its altitude sensor. The team learned and tried again.

alarm.title: Altitude Confusion
alarm.briefing: My altitude sensor thinks I've landed, but I'm still kilometres up! In real life HAKUTO-R crashed. Pick a site and save me!
